name: orbitguard
description: Real-Time Space Situational Awareness, Conjunction Assessment & RF Ground Station
author: Hitesh

scripts.build:desktop: cross-env ELECTRON=true npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build:electron
scripts.build:electron: tsup desktop/main/index.ts --out-dir desktop/dist/main --format cjs --target node20 --clean --external electron --external serialport && tsup desktop/preload/index.ts --out-dir desktop/dist/preload --format cjs --target node20 --clean --external electron
scripts.test: npm test --prefix frontend && npm run test:desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix frontend && tsc -p desktop/tsconfig.json --noEmit
